items.title: Noah Cook Interview, 1960-08-30
items.q: I never see Billika Sam do that. I saw him on the stage.

ctx.x: I can write that. And then I had two, but one of them is too vulgar. He couldn't make that. He couldn't sing that. I know that's good, but I couldn't write that. But Sam, I can write that to old Mule. And I wish I had written it. And my son, yeah, he could. He's sung it if I had written it. But I'll write it if you tell me to write it and I'll send it to you.
